# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 1 token; Text — 4 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 6 tokens; Charts — 15 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 48 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 12 tokens; Radius — 6 tokens; Shadow — 4 tokens; Border — 5 tokens; Size — 48 tokens; Duration — 8 tokens; Easing — 3 tokens; Z index — 5 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--canvas, #f2f3f0);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--canvas, #0e0f11);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f2f3f0;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--canvas` | #f2f3f0 | #0e0f11 | App background behind the Sheet; Hub page background; Spine and ContextBar ground. Brand off-white in light, near-black neutral in dark. Light lifted from #EFF0EE to #F2F3F0 in direction B (25 Oct 2026) so white sheets and the navy brand band separate cleanly. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 56px/58px Syne, "DM Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.035em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-xl); letter-spacing: -0.035em;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/DMSans-Variable.woff2`, `fonts/DMSans-Italic-Variable.woff2` and `fonts/Syne-Variable.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/DMSans-Variable.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/DMSans-Variable.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DM Sans | `fonts/DMSans-Variable.woff2` (weight 100 1000) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-sans)` | `dm-sans` |
| Syne | `fonts/Syne-Variable.woff2` (weight 400 800) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-display)` | `syne` |

Every face: `fonts/DMSans-Variable.woff2` (DM Sans, 100 1000), `fonts/DMSans-Italic-Variable.woff2` (DM Sans, 100 1000, italic), `fonts/Syne-Variable.woff2` (Syne, 400 800).

## Spacing

4px base. Dense by default; use the step, never an in-between value.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 0px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-0);
```

### Tokens (12)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-0` | 0px | No gap. |
| `--space-0-5` | 2px | Icon-to-text nudges, focus-ring offset. |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Tight gaps: pill padding, icon gaps inside controls. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gap between related controls; table cell vertical padding. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Control horizontal padding; table cell horizontal padding. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Field-to-field gap; card padding; mobile page gutter. |
| `--space-5` | 20px | Sheet inner padding on tablet. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Sheet inner padding on desktop; gap between sections in a form. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Gap between major page sections. |
| `--space-10` | 40px | Empty-state padding; Hub section spacing. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Sign-in card padding; launcher top spacing. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Hero spacing on onboarding screens. |

## Shadow

Elevation only for things that float above the Sheet. The Sheet itself is separated by a hairline, not a shadow.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--shadow-1: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 12, 63, 0.05) in the light theme; the table gives its value in the others) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--shadow-1), so that a change to tokens.css, or a change of theme, reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--shadow-1` | 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 12, 63, 0.05) · dark: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) | Hovered app tiles, sticky table header when scrolled. |
| `--shadow-2` | 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 12, 63, 0.08), 0 16px 32px -12px rgba(0, 12, 63, 0.22) · dark: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 0 16px 32px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) | Menus, popovers, tooltips, toasts, date pickers. Also the AppDock sheet that sits over the brand band (direction B: deeper, tighter shadow). |

## Border

Stroke widths. Hairlines separate; controls get a slightly heavier stroke so their boundary reads at 3:1.

### Use


## Size

Fixed dimensions and breakpoints. Touch targets are 44px (touch-target) on coarse pointers and below breakpoint-tablet. CSS media and container queries cannot read custom properties, so bundle.css repeats the breakpoint values; change both together.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--control-sm: 28px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--control-sm), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (48)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--control-sm` | 28px | Small controls inside dense tables and toolbars (desktop only). |
| `--control-md` | 36px | Default height of buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls. |
| `--control-lg` | 44px | Large controls; every control on mobile / coarse pointers. |
| `--touch-target` | 44px | Minimum hit area on touch devices. |
| `--icon-sm` | 16px | Icons inside controls and table cells. |
| `--icon-md` | 20px | Icons in Spine, ContextBar and empty states' small marks. |
| `--icon-lg` | 24px | App icons in Spine and bottom nav. |
| `--row-height` | 44px | Default DataTable row height. |
| `--row-height-dense` | 36px | Dense DataTable row height. |
| `--spine-width` | 232px | Expanded Spine width. |
| `--spine-width-collapsed` | 64px | Collapsed Spine (icons only). |
| `--contextbar-height` | 56px | ContextBar height. |

| `--timepicker-width` | 160px | Time-slot list popover width. |
| `--menu-min-width` | 200px | Minimum width of menus. |
| `--menu-max-width` | 360px | Maximum width of menus. |
| `--cmdk-width` | 640px | Command palette width. |
| `--popover-max-height` | 320px | Max height of listboxes and menus before they scroll. |
| `--panel-max-height` | 560px | Max height of the notifications panel. |

| `--app-tile-min-height` | 156px | Minimum AppTile height so tiles align in the grid. |

| `--breakpoint-tablet` | 768px | Tablet portrait (768–1023px): its own layout — Spine as an icon rail, no bottom nav, drawers as side sheets, two-column forms only where fields are short, search as an icon. |

## Duration

Motion is short and functional. Respect prefers-reduced-motion: durations drop to 0.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--duration-instant: 80ms) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--duration-instant), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--duration-instant` | 80ms | Hover and pressed colour changes. |
| `--duration-intent` | 120ms | Hover intent: how long the pointer rests on an AppDock icon before its card opens (it closes at once). |
| `--duration-fast` | 140ms | Menus, tooltips, toggles, checkbox ticks. |
| `--duration-base` | 220ms | Drawers, dialogs, toasts entering. |
| `--duration-slow` | 360ms | Skeleton shimmer step; the AppDock icons coming in on load (40ms apart). |
| `--duration-playful` | 280ms | Small springy moves in the Hub only: the peach hover line, the dock badge. |
| `--duration-morph` | 340ms | An AppDock icon opening into its card and closing back (Hub only). |
| `--duration-launch` | 420ms | AppLaunch: the app's surface growing out of the tapped card, on ease-standard; the whole open takes about 850ms. |
